reason: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with the TokensForce gateway, providing login onboarding, provider-group configuration, local credential storage through the host, and an embedded usage dashboard.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 TokensForce 词元网关，支持登录配置企业或组提供方，并在会话界面查看用量与费用仪表盘。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the TokensForce token gateway with login-based provider setup and an embedded dashboard for usage and cost information.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the TokensForce model gateway
Provides login-based onboarding and organization or group selection
Stores selected group API credentials through the host credential mechanism
Displays TokensForce usage, cost, and ranking data in an embedded dashboard
